# Evidence and research

Keep raw captures and disposable output under the owning project's ignored workbench/.local/.
Publish sanitised findings with provenance: source revision, input identity,
reproduction command and relevant environment. Preserve historical capture paths
and hashes; record relocations rather than rewriting their provenance.

Separate observed findings, proposed repairs and accepted decisions. Hash equality
proves byte identity, not correctness or freshness. Tests and proposals do not
approve runtime adoption, external writes or publication.

Retain artifacts referenced by active investigations, decisions and unresolved
recovery work. Age alone does not authorise deletion. Use an existing supported
research tool where applicable; this starter does not require a particular engine.
